title: The Seed Casts Twice
summary: Noir paper street. The theft is already over; the second cast is still happening. A child's shadow stays planted on the third step and blooms into a fractal garden. Breath iterates the plants; a hold withdraws them; a flat seed-disc drops into the palm. Lotte Reiniger table, Desmet amber field. Not Daisy. Ladies off the street.
visualArc: Empty street + orphan shadow → child matched then split → canopy hides the disc → hold withdraws branches → disc on the palm, shadow locks.

segments.label: S0 — Waiting Shadow
segments.onScreen: Empty street. A human shadow with no caster. Heel already sprouting G0.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Lotte Reiniger silhouette animation still, backlit glass trick table, tissue-grey street of stacked cut tissue-paper tenements receding paler with distance, iron stoop and fire escape cut from black card, one small stoop lamp. Cream backlight field tinted patent-blue film virage on the clear gelatin only. On the sidewalk a human shadow with no caster in frame, heel already sprouting a first black fern pinna (G0), paper-cut not photoreal plant. Scissors edges, figures stay black, no faces, no text, no neon, no HUD, no seed-as-disc yet, Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: 4 seconds, locked camera, silent. An empty paper street. A shadow with no owner lies on the sidewalk; one more black fern pinna unfolds from its heel as a single cut-paper plate swap, no morph. Nothing else moves. Blue field if used, else amber.

segments.label: S1 — Split
segments.onScreen: Child enters. Body and shadow agree. On the third step the shadow stays and forks.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Lotte Reiniger silhouette animation still, one solid black card puppet of a child about eight years old in strict profile, short coat, small satchel on one strap, flat cap, scissors-cut edges, no eyes drawn, no face detail, no photoreal skin. The body is articulated at shoulder, elbow, hip and knee, with a single paper-fastener glint at the knee where the under-light catches the brass. Mid-stride on the second step, weight on the back foot, front toe just lifting. The child's cast shadow lies on the sidewalk plane directly under the shoes and matches the body exactly, same stride, same cap, one black shape joined at the heels. The job of this frame: body and shadow still agree. Room: a tissue-grey street of stacked tissue tenements, near darker, far paler, an iron stoop and a fire escape in black card, one small stoop lamp, no other figure, no seed-as-disc yet. Light: backlit frosted-glass trick table, one amber field tint on the clear gelatin only, figures stay pure black, no colour inside the puppets. Lens and grade: locked camera, lead-flat plane, no depth of field, 4:3, paper grain, no wet enamel, no HUD, no text, no petals, no field, no tandem, no rivulets, no orb, no 3D mesh. Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: 6 seconds, locked camera, silent. A black card silhouette child takes one step forward on a tissue-grey paper street under an amber field. The shadow does not follow: it stays planted where the last step was, and one black paper fork (G1) appears from its heel as a single cut-plate swap, no morph, no 3D growth. Figures stay black. Photoreal paper on glass, not CGI.

segments.label: S2 — Canopy
segments.onScreen: Child reaches up. Canopy G2 fills the alley. The disc is lost in the lace.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Lotte Reiniger silhouette still, same solid black card child in profile reaching upward with one arm, no eyes drawn, paper-fastener glint at the elbow. From the planted shadow a black paper fractal canopy (G2) fills the alley between the stoops, flat plates, hard scissors edges. Tissue-grey street, stoop lamp, amber field on the clear gelatin only, figures stay black. Seed-as-disc not yet visible. No wet enamel, no HUD, no text, no 3D mesh, Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: 8 seconds, locked camera, silent. The child holds a reach. The black paper canopy adds one generation in one plate swap, G2 to G3 lace-of-shadow, no morph. The disc, if seen, is a flat black coin, then it is gone in the lace. Amber field; optional single hard cut to green and back.

segments.label: S3 — Hold
segments.onScreen: Child holds the breath. Branches withdraw a generation. In a gap, the disc.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Lotte Reiniger silhouette animation still, the same solid black card child about eight in strict profile, short coat, small satchel, flat cap, scissors-cut edges, no eyes drawn, no face detail, perfectly still, long straight spine, chin level, arms down, both palms turned open toward the lens, empty. The paper-fastener glint at the shoulder is the only bright point. Over and behind the child the black paper canopy is withdrawing: G3 lace swapped out for the G2 canopy plate, branches shorter, flat card, no morph. In a clean gap of tissue at chest height, isolated from every branch, hangs one small hard seed-as-disc, a flat black coin-scale card disc at the tip of a single stem, edge-on enough to read as flat, not an orb, not a planet. The job of this frame: the hold works, the garden gives ground, the disc is visible. Room: the same tissue-grey street, tissue tenements near darker and far paler, iron stoop and fire escape in black card, one small stoop lamp, no other figure. Light: backlit frosted-glass trick table, amber field on the clear gelatin only, figures stay pure black. Lens and grade: locked camera, lead-flat plane, no depth of field, 4:3, paper grain, no wet enamel, no HUD, no text, no petals, no field, no tandem, no rivulets, no 3D mesh. Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: 6 seconds, locked camera, silent. The black card child stands still, palms open. The paper garden withdraws in two hard plate swaps, G3 to G2 to G1, no morph, branches getting shorter. A flat black coin-scale disc slides down one stem toward the palms and stops at knee height. Amber field, figures stay black, photoreal paper on glass.

segments.label: S4 — Palm Return
segments.onScreen: Close on a larger hand puppet. Disc on the palm. Last stems go. Shadow locks. Cut.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Lotte Reiniger silhouette animation still, a close replacement puppet, not a crop: one larger solid black card hand and forearm in strict profile entering from the lower left, three times the scale of the walking puppet, four jointed fingers and a thumb pinned separately, palm turned up and open, the paper-fastener glint at the wrist the only bright point, scissors-cut edges, no photoreal skin, no face in frame. On the open palm rests one small hard seed-as-disc, a flat black coin-scale card disc lying flat, not an orb, not a planet, not a bottle. The job: the seed is back and the hand only holds it. At the right frame edge two withdrawing black paper stems (G1 remnant), flat card, cut short, leaning out of frame. On the sidewalk plane beneath them the cast shadow lies obedient and matched, one black shape joined at the wrist. Room: the same tissue-grey street at its near layer only, one dark tissue wall, the foot of the iron stoop in black card, the stoop lamp bracket at the top edge. Light: backlit frosted-glass trick table, amber field on the clear gelatin only, figures stay pure black. Lens and grade: locked camera, lead-flat plane, no depth of field, 4:3, paper grain, no wet enamel, no HUD, no text, no petals, no field, no tandem, no rivulets, no 3D mesh. Grok Imagine style
